capabilities: Set a self-hosted Outpost API base URL in settings
Pair with a one-time code from the Jarvis PWA and store a device token
Pull vault content incrementally into the open vault folder
Show idle/syncing/error status in the status bar
Revoke device access from the host
disambiguation: Not a two-way sync tool; it only pulls from the server and never writes back through the plugin.
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README warns against lookalike plugins with a different id and notes the server admin can disable new pairing; installable via BRAT or manual release files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull vault content from a self-hosted Jarvis Outpost control plane, and the plugin deliberately offers no default server.

relations.evidence: an Obsidian read-only client for a self-hosted Jarvis Outpost control plane

summary: Read-only sync client that pulls vault notes from a user-run Jarvis Outpost API into the local Obsidian vault.
